title: Scooter tour of Barcelona
text: I loved this tour. I like the E-scooters in general and I think that it's a great way to quickly make it around an urban area. Barcelona is a gorgeous city and while on the scooter you can be in the midst of it. You're breathing the air, on the ground, and you can feel the city around you. I estimate that we covered a good 25% of the city in the three hours. We sort of went through time, starting in the old Roman sector, through the medieval parts, and on to the modern city. You can breeze from site to site and still experience the feel of Barcelona. I need to do this in other cities!
author: Kevin_T

title: Great Barcelona Tour!
text:
My husband and I had a great time on the scooter tour with Alex! When we arrived, we were worried the place was closed, but Alex arrived a couple minutes after to open the store! Because it was just us on the tour, it was almost a private tour! We saw the Montjuic cactus garden, a little bit of the Gothic Quarter, went all the way to the the Parc de La Ciutadella and saw the Columbus monument too. During the tour, Alex answered our questions and showed us maps and pictures of what Barcelona looked like in Roman times, and throughout history! We had an amazing time! Thank you, Alex!
